prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury attorney for every car-accident case in Chicago — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, how serious your injuries are, whether liability is disputed, whether you’ll need a trial, and your priorities (fast settlement vs. maximum recovery, local boutique vs. large firm, etc.).

How to find the best attorney for your case
- Look for relevant experience: attorneys who focus on motor vehicle crashes and have trial experience with cases like yours (catastrophic injury, permanent impairment, wrongful death, disputed liability, etc.).
- Proven results: published settlements/verdicts and client testimonials for similar cases.
- Reputation and credentials: AV Preeminent/AVVO/Super Lawyers/Martindale-Hubbell ratings, peer reviews, and board certifications (where applicable).
- Communication and accessibility: a lawyer who returns calls, explains options clearly, and will keep you informed.
- Fee arrangement and costs: most work on contingency (typical contingency fee in Illinois is around 33%–40% depending on stage and complexity). Get fee and expense details in writing.
- Resources: for serious injury claims you want a firm with investigators, medical experts, and trial-ready resources.
- Verify standing: check the Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission (ARDC) for license and discipline history.

Where to look
- Illinois Trial Lawyers Association / Chicago Bar Association referrals
- Super Lawyers, Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell for ratings and reviews
- Google and Yelp client reviews (read several, not just one)
- Local news reports or legal publications listing major verdicts/settlements

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine? What were results?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? (attorney or paralegal)
- What is your contingency fee and what costs will I be responsible for?
- What is a realistic timeline and settlement range?
- Can you provide references from past clients?

Well-known Chicago firms that frequently handle serious car-accident claims
(If you want names to start your search, these firms are widely known in the Chicago market for personal injury work. I recommend researching them and confirming current ratings/case results.)
- Clifford Law Offices (noted for major injury and wrongful-death cases)
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard (known for serious injury litigation)

If you want, I can:

- Draft a list of specific questions to ask at consultations.
- Help interpret fee agreements or a settlement offer if you have one.
